list.caption: Projects: number, client, step, documents, due date, owner

all.title: No projects yet

documents.createContractLabel: Create a contract draft from the quote

execution.none: No shipment yet: it is created after the contract is signed.

journal.title: Document log
journal.empty: No entries yet. Here you will see who did what with the contract, invoice and act, and when.

contract.sent_to_client: Contract draft sent to the client for agreement
contract.client_agreed: Contract wording agreed by the client
contract.scan_attached: Scan of the signed contract attached

act.scan_attached: Scan of the signed act attached

panel.journalHint: Entries appear after the first actions on the contract and act.

none.title: No contract yet
none.text: The contract draft is created from the accepted quote by the accountant or the director.

consequence.title: What will happen
consequence.step1: A contract draft with the status “Draft” appears from the accepted quote.
consequence.step2: The client cannot see it yet: you send it for agreement.
consequence.step3: The project log records who created the draft and when.

state.project: The draft has not been sent to the client yet.
state.atClient: The draft is with the client for wording agreement.
state.client_agreed: The client agreed the wording. Next, issue the contract at the e-document operator (outside the platform).
state.issued_at_operator: The contract is issued at the operator. When both sides have signed, attach the scan.
state.signed: The contract is signed by both sides, the scan is stored.
state.rejected: The client rejected the contract. Fix the draft and send it for agreement again.

consequence.title: What will happen
send_to_client: The client sees the contract draft in the cabinet: “Please agree the contract wording”.
The client gets a notification on their channels.
The log records who sent the draft and when.
client_agreed: The contract gets the status “Agreed by client”.
Next it is issued at the e-document operator, outside the platform.
The log records who marked the agreement and when.
mark_issued: The contract gets the status “Issued at operator”.
The client sees “Contract is being signed”.
When both sides have signed at the operator, attach the scan: the contract becomes “Signed”.
attach_scan: The contract becomes “Signed (scan)”; the file is stored.
The project moves to payment: ERP creates a draft prepayment invoice.
The log records who attached the scan and when.
revise: The draft returns to “Draft”; the client's agreement is reset.
Send the corrected draft to the client as a separate action.

note.label: Operator or number in the e-document system

reject.title: The client rejected the contract

reason.label: Reason for rejection
reason.hint: Required: as told by the client, it goes to the log.

reject.disabled: The button becomes available when you write a reason.

scan.label: Scan of the signed contract
scan.hint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 20 MB.
scan.choose: Choose a scan file — the button becomes available.

contract.historyEmpty: No actions on the contract yet.

done.client_agreed: Marked: the client agreed the wording.
done.mark_issued: Marked: contract issued at the operator.

contract.readOnly: Actions on the contract are available to the director and the accountant.

none.title: No act yet
none.noInvoice: The act is issued against an issued invoice. No invoice has been issued yet — issue it in “Invoices & payments”.
none.forbidden: Acts are issued by the director and the accountant.
none.ready: The invoice is issued: you can issue the act.
consequence: The act gets a number and the status “Issued”.
The act PDF is built from the invoice; the log records who issued it and when.

state.issued: The act is with the client for acceptance. When they sign, attach the scan.
state.signed: The act is signed, the scan is stored.
state.returned: The client returned the act with a reason. Fix it and issue it again.

consequence.title: What will happen
attach_scan: The act becomes “Signed (scan)”; the file is stored.
When all invoices are paid, the project becomes “Completed”.
The log records who attached the scan and when.
reissue: The same act with the same number is issued again.

return.title: The customer returned the act

reason.label: Reason for return
reason.hint: Required: as told by the customer, it goes to the log and to the issuer.

return.disabled: The button becomes available when you write a reason.

scan.label: Scan of the signed act
scan.hint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 20 MB.
scan.choose: Choose a scan file — the button becomes available.

act.historyEmpty: No actions on the act yet.
act.readOnly: Actions on the act are available to the director and the accountant.

files.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
files.wrongType: A PDF or an image is needed: JPG, PNG, WEBP.
files.generating: The file is still being prepared. Try again in a few seconds.

errors.contract_transition_not_allowed: The contract is already in another status. Refresh the page.
errors.act_sign_not_allowed: The act is already in another status. Refresh the page.
errors.act_already_exists: The project already has an act.
errors.no_invoice: The act is issued against an issued invoice: there is none yet.
errors.contract_exists: The contract draft is already created.
errors.contract_create_not_allowed: Only the accountant or the director can create the contract draft.
errors.act_issue_not_allowed: Only the accountant or the director can issue the act.

errors.forbidden: This action is not allowed for your role.
errors.unavailable: ERP is not responding. Try again later.
errors.payload: The file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.unknown: It did not work. Try again.

loadError.title: Could not load

unavailable.title: ERP is not responding

forbidden.title: No access

notFound.title: Project not found
